purpose: Measure selective loss between the frozen candidate universe and the accepted transfer-scoring cohort; bound the full-universe effect without assuming missing-at-random adjudication.

terminal_decisions.meaning: Blinded reviewers accept the candidate's predeclared relation hypothesis; item enters transfer-scoring cohort.
Reviewers cannot reliably decide relation/equivalence; item is retained in denominator but not scored as an accepted relation.
Reviewers reject the predeclared relation hypothesis; item is retained in denominator but not scored in that relation.
Candidate is a duplicate of another candidate under the preregistered duplicate policy; retained in attrition accounting.
Candidate violates generation, freeze, lineage, or evaluation protocol; retained in attrition accounting.

freeze_contract.relation_matrix: Every task-family × difficulty-band cell contains all six exposure-transfer relations.

hash_contract.canonicalization: Serialize typed structs as compact serde_json; sort manifest candidates and adjudication records by candidate_id; sort reviewer_ids inside each adjudication record; sort item IDs before item-set digest.

estimand.missingness_assumption: No missing-at-random assumption. Every excluded candidate receives the worst-case binary effect interval [-1,+1].
estimand.zero_accepted_items: The cell is non-estimable on the accepted subset; full candidate effect remains bounded by [-1000,+1000] permille.

aggregation.relation_effect: Equal-weight difficulty bands within each family, then equal-weight families.
aggregation.uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals across independent model-pair training replicates; questions, candidates and adjudicators are not independent training replicates.
aggregation.coverage: Report pooled candidate-volume acceptance and family-macro acceptance separately.

required_outputs: frozen candidate count by relation × task family × difficulty band
accepted, indeterminate, rejected, duplicate and protocol-invalid counts
acceptance rate and reviewer disagreement by cell
full-candidate worst-case lower and upper effect bounds
per-model-pair bounds and family-macro relation bounds
candidate-manifest, adjudication-report, lineage and transfer-study digests

qualification_targets.claim_rule: Report full-candidate bounds beside accepted-subset effects; a narrow accepted-subset interval cannot substitute for a wide partial-identification interval.

claim_ceiling: Bounds are conservative under binary item outcomes and the declared treatment-minus-placebo estimand.
Bounds do not repair incorrect labels among accepted items or identify the reason for disagreement.
A wide bound is an honest non-result, not evidence of no effect.
The protocol does not authenticate reviewer identity or evaluator custody.
Global model parameter updates can create interference across relation strata.
No causal direct-effect, FDR-control, external-validity or SOTA claim follows from a passing schema or synthetic test.
